title: GSG's New Universe
description: Unlock the gates to infinite dimensions with iron and diamond portals! Explore unique worlds and hidden mysteries in GSG's New Universe.
body:
![Portals](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eaa0f19b6e3c87647ad2784025892d70193ad68f.jpeg) 

🌌 GSG's NEW UNIVERSE
GSG's NEW UNIVERSE is a comprehensive content expansion mod for Minecraft, designed to introduce unique, resource-rich dimensions through a custom portal system.

📦 Features
Custom Dimensions: Adds specialized dimensions for Coal, Iron, and Gold, streamlining your resource acquisition.
Portal Integration: Introduces custom-built portals that provide seamless transition to new worlds.
Survival Enhanced: Perfect for both casual players and builders, significantly reducing the time spent on manual mining.

🛠️ Installation Guide
Mod Loader: Ensure you have the NeoForge/Forge/Fabric loader installed for your version of Minecraft
Installation: Place the downloaded .jar file into your mods folder.
Configuration: No external configuration is required. The mod is designed to work out of the box with standard survival settings.

🔍 Performance & Compatibility
Compatibility: Fully compatible with Minecraft.
Hardware: This mod is optimized for standard desktop environments. If you encounter any performance issues or bugs, please provide your system specifications and crash logs.

🐛 How to Report Issues
We strive for a stable experience. If you encounter any unexpected behavior or bugs, please use the Issue Tracker linked at the top of the page. When reporting, please include:
A brief description of the issue.
Your current mod list.
Any relevant crash logs (if applicable).
